summary.name: Awesome Python Sponsorship
summary.one_liner: A sponsorship page for awesome-python.com, the curated list of Python libraries and tools in the vinta/awesome-python GitHub repo, offering paid logo and link placement for developers and companies.
use_cases: Promote a Python library or developer tool to professional developers
Get a product listed at the top of a popular curated Python list
Find sponsorship tiers for a solo indie Python founder
Reach developers evaluating tools for production use
summary.what_it_does: The page describes paid sponsorship options for the awesome-python list, which is the #10 most-starred repo on GitHub according to the listing. Sponsors get a logo and/or text link pinned at the top of the README and a link on awesome-python.com. Tiers are Headline Sponsor ($500/month or $4,500/year), Featured Sponsor ($200/month or $1,800/year), and Indie Dev Sponsor ($99/month, $249/quarter, or $891/year, limited to founder-led one-person companies). The page states that the audience is mid-to-senior Python developers making adoption decisions, and that sponsorship does not affect which projects are listed. Sponsor links carry UTM tags for click tracking.
notable: Indie Dev tier for solo founders at $99/month
Sponsorship does not influence which projects are listed, per the page
Sponsor links include UTM tags for analytics
Payment by card via Open Collective, US bank transfer, or PayPal
caveats: Sponsorship is paid; tiers range from $99/month to $500/month, with annual and quarterly discounts
Indie Dev tier is only for founder-led one-person companies; funded startups and larger companies must use Featured or Headline
Sponsor text, logos, or links may be changed or rejected if misleading, off-topic, or incompatible with README formatting
